claims.claim: PTE-03 authenticated the original capture and AssertionError/Failed exception types (SOURCE_PROVEN); failing node and source line were absent from its bounded projection (SOURCE_MISSING). One focused reproduction established fixture defects. After correction, six selected cases reported passing assertions, but pytest exited 1 for an xdist collection/profile/toolchain conflict. Canonical verification success is not claimed.
consult_flow exposes one optional read-only interface accepting exactly ARCHITECTURE, TASK_AUTHORING, REPAIR_AUTHORING and REMEDIATION_AUTHORING, with disabled defaults and explicit Human opt-out.

Requests bind the caller-resolved flow, canonical packet/source, sealed cut, exact subject and candidate fingerprint; contract fixtures exercise source, revision, run, review, finding and candidate substitutions.
The wrapper reuses CAA-02 consultation and validation for bounded recommendations, citations, uncertainty and falsifiers, retaining explicit abstention and unavailable outcomes.
Mapping and JSON transports share request semantics and independent response validation; four-flow simulation fixtures cover malformed, overbudget, attribution-mismatched and injected responses.
Packet currentness preserves Human choices and original TASK obligations. Advice retains Brain final semantic judgment and leaves final-family validation and direct authoring separate.
REPAIR binds the failed RUN/head/Executor and caller-proposed action; REMEDIATION binds the selected finding, review, reviewed SHA and required action without selecting replacements.

Optional consultation outcomes retain unchanged authoring policy and mandatory canonical guards. The timeout fixture now holds its provider call until explicit cleanup, preserving deterministic outstanding-call and busy assertions.

Historical consultations retain the original cut. Corrected movement fixtures replace the RESULT ref actually pinned by that cut, preserve its original RUN identity and require SOURCE_MOVED before consultation or after transport failure.
Planning and documentation record explicit CAA-03 selection, preserve prior CAA-01/02 history and separate TASK-411 lineage, and retain CAA-04/05 nonselection without default production activation.

The repair commit directly descends from the exact failed candidate and changes only tests/test_caa_integration.py. Strict historical CAA-02 assertions remain bound to their reviewed snapshot; existing policy, provider, authoring and lifecycle authority surfaces are preserved.
